# v0.1.0: dashboard, moves, Live and tools (2026-11-23)

## A. Unified moves table and calculator

### Moves
- **One table:** each Pokémon's moves are now a single table with these columns: Method | Level | Move | Type | Category | Power | Accuracy | PP.
- **One row per move:** every method a move is learned by is kept on that row, with its levels.
- **Method mapping:** the client's own learn methods are kept and labelled:

  | Client value | Shown as |
  |---|---|
  | `level` at level 1 | Start |
  | `level` at other levels | Level N |
  | `EVOLVE` | Evolve |
  | `EGG` | Egg |
  | `EGG & ITEM` | Egg + item |
  | `TUTOR` | Tutor |
  | `SPECIAL` | Special |
  | `PREVO` | Pre-evolution |
  | anything else | Other, with the raw label |

- **Completeness:** across all 649 species, 62,729 move records become 62,729 method entries. Only exact duplicates are dropped, and the dump has none.
- **Missing metadata:** shown as "—" (164 records, mostly later-generation moves such as Snowscape). Nothing is invented.
- **Sorting and filters:** sorting by method, level, move and type; filter chips for All, Level-up, TM/HM, Egg, Tutor, Evolve and Other.
- **Where it works:** the Summary and the Pokédex popout.

**What "TM??" means.** It is the client's own label, set in `monsters.json`. For Bulbasaur it includes Gen I machines (Rage, Bide, Razor Wind), HMs (Cut, Strength, Flash) and moves that elsewhere were only egg or tutor moves. In other words, it is broad machine compatibility.

The client's item data has 279 "TM - <move>" and 11 "HM - <move>" items. All 287 distinct TM?? moves have a matching item: 276 TM, 11 HM, and Flash, Rock Smash and Whirlpool exist as both.

The badge therefore says:
- **TM / HM / TM/HM:** taken from your client's items, and links to the item in the Item Library.
- **TM??:** when no matching item exists. This never happened in the 2026-11-16 dump.

Every machine badge keeps a "?" marker and a tooltip saying the client lists it as "TM??", and a note under the table says that where to get the machine and its price are not covered.

### Calculator (Tools › Calculator)
- **Arithmetic:** exact fractions (BigInt), so 0.1 + 0.2 = 0.3. Results are rounded only for display, to 12 decimals.
- **Pocket-calculator chaining:** 2 + 3 × 4 = 20, and repeated "=" repeats the last operation.
- **Percent:** a + b% means b% of a; on its own, b% is b/100.
- **Other keys:** sign toggle, backspace, clear, and a "Can't divide by zero" state.
- **Keyboard:** digits, + − * /, Enter, Backspace, Esc, % and F9. Typing in other fields is ignored.
- **Access:** can be pinned to Quick Access and has its own resizable popout (tool `calculator`).

## B. Navigation and Collection
- **Main navigation:** Home, Pokédex, Type matchups, Notes, Collection, Tools, Live, Guides, with Alt+1…8.
- **Horizontal mode:** labels give way to icons (tooltips keep the names) below 1260 px, so nothing overflows.
- **Quick Access default:** no longer repeats Type matchups. Saved lists are untouched.
- **Collection** has two tabs: My Pokémon (the manually curated Box) and Showcases.
  - The same records, APIs and popouts are used; no migration.
  - `#/tools/box/…` and `#/tools/showcase/…` redirect to `#/collection/pokemon/…` and `#/collection/showcases/…`.
  - Nothing is imported from the Pokédex.
- **Fixed:** a pre-existing crash in the Box list (`x === sel`) whenever it held at least one entry.

## C. Home
- **Default sections:** roaming Legendaries · Alpha & Swarm · latest official update · more updates · official events · Quick access.
- **Off by default:** storyline run and favourites (Settings › Appearance › Home sections). Altering Cave is no longer on Home; it stays in Live.
- **Lists saved by older builds** are translated, not discarded:
  - update → update + news
  - live → live + roamers
  - shortcuts → quick + run
- **Official news status** moved into the latest-update card's footer: feed state, automatic check, summaries date, new posts and Check now.
- **Events:** upcoming events first; at most two concluded ones, and only when nothing upcoming is confirmed.
- **Roaming Legendaries:** two cards with animated Gen V sprites from your library (only these two GIFs on Home; a still with reduced motion or the pause setting), plus region, types, the next month's pair, and the "Community cycle — not checked in-game" note with its source.

## D. Live
- **Current / recently reported:**
  - Only Alpha and Swarm reports whose estimated window is open, or just closed ("Status uncertain").
  - Several reports of the same Pokémon at the same place within one window form one card, timed from the earliest report ("reported 2×").
  - TEST entries and old history never appear here.
  - Reports that name several Pokémon show their own title and are not merged by species.
- **Timers (estimates only):**
  - Alpha: 75 min (official changelog).
  - Swarm: 20 min, a provisional community estimate (reports say about 15, 20 or 30 min), adjustable from 5 to 120 min in Settings › Live.
  - Timers count from the report time; a report time is not the spawn time.
  - States: Likely active → Status uncertain (window passed, up to max(15 min, half the window) later) → Old · likely ended / Replayed history. Other: TEST, Report (no timer).
  - Nothing is called "confirmed active", and there is no next-spawn countdown.
- **Robustness:**
  - Future timestamps (clock difference) fall back to the time received, with a note.
  - Reports that arrive after their window are noted.
  - Server time is used for "now".
  - Timers tick every 15 s; the list is re-fetched every minute and on visibility change (sleep/resume); expired timers trigger a refresh.
- **Caught-up reports:** reports caught up after (re)connecting count by their own timestamp and are labelled "caught up on reconnect" (setting `live.current_include_catchup`). Otherwise "Current" would be empty after every restart.
- **Report history** below keeps search, filters, TEST entries, raw source details and notification controls.
- **Home** shows up to four current cards with the same timers.

## Not verified
- Native Qt/KDE (XCB or Wayland) was not run here; only the Qt stub test and headless Chrome were.
- Alphapedia's live feed was not connected; reports in tests are seeded in the recorded payload shape.
